name: Automated Data Analysis Tool
headline: Automated Data Analysis Tool - Data Analyst Agent
short_description: The data-analyst-agent is an automated data analysis tool leveraging large models to streamline the analysis of Excel/CSV data. It generates visual recap reports and features five distinct agent operation modes for comparative learning and exploration.
author: chenningling

sections.overview:
The data-analyst-agent is an LLM-based automation tool designed to streamline data analysis workflows. Upload Excel or CSV files and describe your analysis requirements; the agent automatically plans analysis tasks, generates Python code, executes it safely, and compiles results into Markdown reports with interactive visualizations. It supports five distinct agent operation modes—tool-driven (recommended), task-driven, hybrid, autonomous, and staged—each representing different architectural approaches for learning and comparison. The tool provides real-time progress updates via WebSocket, includes task management and session logging, and supports rich visualizations through ECharts, Mermaid diagrams, and matplotlib charts. Ideal for analysts who want to accelerate exploratory data analysis without writing code manually.
Automating data analysis tasks
Generating visual reports from datasets
Comparing different analysis methodologies
Streamlining data-driven decision making
sections.usage:
```
Analyze the following [DATA] file for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Generate a visual recap report and use the comparative learning mode to identify trends. Focus on [SPECIFIC_METRIC] over the last [TIME_PERIOD].
```
